items.headline: Missouri jumps to 14th in AP Top 25; Florida tumbles 8 spots
items.description: Missouri jumped to No. 14 in the AP Top 25 following its rout of Florida, while the Gators dropped eight spots to No. 16 and were replaced by LSU in the top 10.

items.headline: Conner Weigman's 3 second-half touchdowns rally No. 20 Houston past UCF 27-17
items.description: — Conner Weigman threw for 239 yards and rushed for three second-half touchdowns, and No. 20 Houston rallied to beat Central Florida 27-17 on Saturday.
